title: Medellín Primera Línea gathering from Tricentenario toward Avenida Barranquilla
scope: Local gathering/march. Keep its Tricentenario count separate from the later UdeA confrontation, whose relationship is unresolved.
organizer: Primera Línea, as identified by press; exact convenor unknown.
participants_original: El Colombiano reports about 250, primarily Primera Línea, at Tricentenario; Infobae separately reports about 200 at a later confrontation near UdeA. Do not combine.
participants_precision: approximate count at Tricentenario; not route-wide
threshold_50_evidence: About 250 at Tricentenario exceeds 50; the separate ~200 UdeA count is not transferred.

occurrence.summary: Jan28 Tricentenario gathering moved toward Avenida Barranquilla.

start_date.summary: The report dates this activity to Jan28.

location.summary: S001 planned Tricentenario; S003 reports actual gathering and movement toward Avenida Barranquilla.

organizer.summary: Primera Línea named; no formal convenor.

demands.summary: Reports concern rising food/fuel/utility or service costs and public education, university access and student transport.

participants.summary: About250 at Tricentenario; separate later ~200 near UdeA may or may not be same stage.

protester_violence.summary: S003 reports road blocking, tire fires and damage later that day, but the relation of that action to the approximately 250 people counted at Tricentenario versus a later UdeA confrontation is unresolved; do not transfer the violence flag across an unverified episode boundary.

state_response.summary: ESMAD intervention reported; specific response dimension is not established.

end_date.summary: Reduced intensity later does not establish physical end.

notes: Do not merge with later UdeA confrontation or other 28E cities. S003 attributes road blocking, tire fires and damage to later protest activity, but the link to the Tricentenario-counted cohort is unresolved; violence for this boundary remains unknown. ESMAD intervention alone is not coded as specific dispersal.
open_questions: Were Tricentenario and UdeA one gathering or separate?
What were end time and exact route-wide attendance?
Which demands were directed to a specific government body?

title: Medellín motorcycle procession against Pico y Placa and SOAT costs
location: From Centro Comercial San Diego north toward Puente de la Madre Laura / Puente 4 Sur, Medellín
scope: Evening motorcycle procession, separate from Tricentenario unless evidence links them.
participants_original: S002: about 200 motorcyclists; S003: about 400 motorcyclists. Preserve as separate attributed estimates, not a statistical interval.
participants_precision: conflicting approximate source estimates; not numeric bounds
threshold_50_evidence: Each source reports an approximate participant count of motorcyclists (~200 or ~400), both above 50 people; these are people described as motorcyclists, not a vehicle count. Conflicting estimates do not define lower and upper bounds.

location.summary: Route from San Diego toward Madre Laura/4 Sur bridge.

demands.summary: Opposition to SOAT costs and Pico y Placa restrictions.

participants.summary: S002 estimates about 200 motorcyclists; S003 about 400. Keep both source-attributed estimates; neither defines an event-level lower or upper bound.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Both attributed estimates count motorcyclists as participants and individually exceed 50; do not read the difference as a statistical interval or vehicle total.

protester_violence.summary: No specific violence by this procession established.

state_response.summary: No response to this procession established.

notes: Pico y Placa is a public restriction policy; SOAT cost is an additional grievance. The two approximate crowd figures are source-specific estimates, not min/max bounds. Do not merge with First Línea march.
open_questions: Which estimate describes the full procession?
Are the reports independent, and what were route/end time and state response?

source_access.summary: S010 body read; S012 remained unread after CacheMiss and exact-URL DNS failure before HTTP; no denial.

Establish physical ends and any dispersal/outcomes.
